Frequently Asked Questions

Are my PDF and password uploaded?

No. The encryption happens entirely in your browser. Neither the PDF nor the password ever leaves your device, and we never see them.

How secure is it?

The PDF is encrypted with AES-256, the strongest encryption in the PDF standard. Its security depends on your password: a long password that is hard to guess is much safer than a short or common one.

What if I forget the password?

The PDF cannot be opened without it, and there is no way for us to recover it. Keep the password somewhere safe, or keep an unprotected copy of the original.

Will the protected PDF open everywhere?

Yes. Adobe Acrobat, browsers, phone PDF viewers and other readers all support AES-256 protected PDFs and will ask for the password.
